suite: annotate rail and scene (hover, pick, per-body visibility, type chips, gap alerts)
expect_red: [real] each type chip hides its row kind and only that, the choice is remembered, and pressing it again restores it

mutations.contract: A hidden kind puts its class on the tree, which the stylesheet hides.
mutations.note: The choice is stored and never applied.
mutations.find: for (const kind of AA.SWEEP_ROW_KINDS) root.classList.toggle("an__tree--no-" + kind, hidden.indexOf(kind) !== -1);
mutations.replace: for (const kind of AA.SWEEP_ROW_KINDS) root.classList.toggle("an__tree--no-" + kind, false);
